# The sha384 of every migration's bytes.
#
# A database records the sha384 of a migration's bytes when it applies
# it, and a database that applied the old bytes refuses to start when
# the file's bytes change: the checksum in `_sqlx_migrations` no longer
# matches and the migrator errors out. A migration's bytes are
# therefore immutable once any database has applied them, and the rule
# is only as good as the record of what those bytes are.
#
# This file is that record. The build compares each migration's bytes
# with the line below and fails when they differ, when a migration has
# no line, or when a line has no migration. A change that is meant
# belongs in a new migration.
#
# The values are the sha384 of the file's bytes, lowercase hex.
#
# version  sha384
